noise.entry: ISPlaceTrap.perform creates IsoTrap from the admitted weapon
noise.property: IsoTrap constructor copies HandWeapon.getNoiseRange and getNoiseDuration
noise.effect: IsoTrap.triggerExplosion(false), offsets 94-127: positive noise range calls WorldSoundManager.addSound; updateSounds repeats sound during NoiseDuration
noise.consumer: IsoZombie.RespondToSound obtains WorldSoundManager sounds and attraction, then may turn and pathToSound at offsets 734-749
noise.limit: Only admitted placement with positive NoiseRange; no guarantee that every zombie responds, no damage or safety claim.

power.effect: IsoGenerator.setSurroundingElectricity checks activation, spatial bounds and AllowExteriorGenerator; offsets 402-430 setHaveElectricity on eligible squares
power.consumers: Same method registers powered clothes dryers, washers, combination appliances, stoves, televisions, radios and refrigerated containers
power.limit: Nearby electrical equipment; outdoor supply follows sandbox permission, no unlimited range or universal compatibility claim.
